Shining with the ancient nobility of templar tradition, '''Valour''' is a [[knights|knightly]] skill that may be thought of as having three distinct parts. The first part, eaglery involves the raising, training, and use of [[eagles]]. The second part of Valour is [[archery]]. By gaining the abilities to assess wind direction and speed and use different kinds of [[bows|weapons]] (longbows, crossbows, darkbows) you may attack from afar, or shoot at a cowardly opponent who has fled to the skies. The third and final part involves an assortment of aggressive abilities ranging from howling a Battlecry, to Engaging your unlucky opponent, to boosting your prowess with Fury.

The skill of Valour is available only to members of the [[Paladin]] [[class]], although most of its abilities are shared with the [[Dominion]], [[Malignity]], and [[Discipline]] skills of the [[Unnamable]], [[Infernal]], and [[Runewarden]] classes.  Like the other warrior-classes, Paladins train in [[Weaponmastery]], but the fiery arts of [[Excision]] are unique to them.

==Abilities in Valour==
{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Eagle
 |description=Your loyal companion.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=EAGLE
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=The golden eagles serve only those loyal to the Bloodsworn divine, forming a lifelong partnership with a paladin in their struggle against the forces of Evil, Chaos, and Darkness. </p><p>Your eagle comes to you with assorted statistics which have been randomly assigned. </p><p>If you cause your eagle to die, you will be refused another eagle. There is absolutely no excuse for killing or conspiring to kill your eagle. </p><p>Below is a list of commands that may be used once you have gotten your eagle. </p><p>EAGLE ASSESS : See information about your eagle.<br>EAGLE RECALL : Recall your eagle to your shoulder. <br>EAGLE SANCTUARY : Order your eagle to a sanctuary where it will be safe. <br>EAGLE LAND : Order your eagle to land on the ground.<br>EAGLE CIRCLE : Order your eagle to fly up into the skies.<br>EAGLE TRAIN : Order your eagle to go train, in order to raise a stat. <br>EAGLE REPORT : Gain information on where your eagle is.<br>EAGLE SLAY : Order your eagle to slay someone.<br>EAGLE HUNT : When your eagle is hungry, have it go hunt for its food. <br>EAGLE FLEE : Set the amount of health remaining when your eagle will flee battle. <br>EAGLE SLEEP : Order your eagle to sleep.<br>EAGLE FEED RAT : Feed the corpses of rats to your eagle.</p><p>As your eagle gains in<br>'''Stamina''': its health will increase.<br>'''Speed''': it will attack more quickly as well as fly from place to place more quickly. <br>'''Strength''': it will attack with more power as well as be able to carry larger items.</p>
}}

 |description=Barging your opponents.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=BARGE <target> <direction>
 |required=
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=4.00 seconds of balance
 |detail=This ability will barge an adventurer to the direction you choose. To start the ability, you must be in a room adjacent to the room where the target adventurer resides, and you must choose to barge him in a direction that wouldn't take him into the room you are in. {{Skill_detail
 |skill=Quivers
 |description=Take full advantage of your quiver.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=ENVENOM ARROW[S] [number of arrows] <colour> <venom><br>INSPECT QUIVER<br>DYE <number of arrows> ARROW[S] <colour><br>SWITCH <colour>
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=Your mastery of quivers allows you to dye and envenom arrows from vials in your possession to be stored in your quiver.<p>When envenoming arrows, if a number of arrows is provided, you will dye and envenom that number of undyed arrows the colour and venom selected. Otherwise, you will coat all your arrows of the selected colour with the venom of your choice. </p><p>Inspecting your quiver will show you how many of each colour arrow you possess and what venoms they have been covered with. </p><p>Further, you may dye any number of undyed arrows the colour of your choice. However, you will find yourself unable to do so if you have arrows of that colour envenomed within your quiver.</p><p>Colours you may use are red, blue, purple, green, black, white, grey, orange, gold, and silver.</p><p>To switch to using a specific colour of arrow, simply SWITCH <colour>. If you wish to switch back to using undyed arrows, simply do SWITCH NORMAL.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Fury
 |description=Temporarily raise your strength.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=FURY [ON/OFF]<br>RELAX FURY
 |required=
 |target=Self
 |cooldown=2.00 seconds of equilibrium
 |detail=This will allow you to temporarily raise your strength with 2 points, for no more than a total of 1/4th of each Achaean day. Your endurance losses will be significantly higher while Fury is active.
